Thanks again for the walkthrough today — useful for our leadership team.

Quick recap / asks from our side so we can move to a short POC:
- Goal: validate latency & cost on our representative workload (chat + embeddings for triage).
- Timeline: ideally start first week of April, 3-4 week evaluation window.
- Success criteria: avg p95 latency < 400ms for chat at our expected concurrency, embeddings similarity >= 0.88 vs current baseline, no data exfiltration.
- Stakeholders: Jake Miller (app/product owner), Procurement (procurement@horizoncare.com), Security (TBD), Infra (TBD).

Can you send a proposed evaluation plan + RACI so we can assign internal owners? Also any pre-reqs for infra/networking or firewall rules we should expect.

Hi Hannah — thanks for the clear recap. Attaching a draft RACI and a proposed POC timeline to kick things off (raci_matrix.xlsx, poc_tl_timeline.pdf). High level notes below and asks for you:

Proposed plan (summary):
- Kickoff: 2026-04-06 (wk of Apr 6) — 1 hour tech kickoff with infra + app + security.
- Duration: 3 weeks execution + 1 week buffer for final QA and scoring (total 4 weeks).
- Success criteria (vendor side): p95 latency < 400ms at 5 concurrent sessions; embedding recall >= 0.88 vs provided eval set; end-to-end request logging/audit visible to HorizonCare team.
- Pre-reqs: network allowlist for our ephemeral ingress (we support VPC peering or TLS over public endpoints with IP allowlist); we'll need a test dataset and a representative prompt set (Hannah/Jake).

RACI (proposed owners from Redwood):
- Redwood Solutions Engineer (owner): lauren_bishop — overall POC execution, data ingestion, eval sets, success criteria measurement.
- Redwood Infra/Deployment (support): dylan_brooks — network setup, VPC connectivity, deployment configuration, monitoring hooks.
- Redwood Security/Compliance (consult): rishi_malhotra — SOC2 evidence, data handling, encryption at rest/in transit.

Asks for HorizonCare:
- App owner: confirm Jake as primary decision-maker for acceptance criteria.
- Infra owner: please confirm who on your team will coordinate VPC/network testing.
- Security contact for questionnaire (rishi will send SOC2 snippets and an evidence checklist).
- Procurement timeline & any required contract terms (procurement@horizoncare.com).

Next steps I recommend:
1) Confirm POC kickoff date (proposed Apr 6).
2) Assign infra & security owners on your side.
3) Share representative dataset and 20-30 prompt examples for evaluation.

I'll follow up with calendar invites and the kickoff agenda once we confirm owners and date.

Thanks — happy to own the SE work for this POC. Quick notes on acceptance criteria / evaluation plan:
- Performance: measure p50/p95 latency on a 1k token window + concurrency ramp test to 5 sessions.
- Quality: embedding similarity measured against your labeled set (we'll provide tooling to compute cosine and aggregate recall).
- Reliability: no errors > 1% of calls and stable KV cache behavior for chat context.
- Observability: token-level cost breakdown and per-request trace link visible in console.

I'll prepare a simple evaluation harness (script + instructions) we can run against Redwood endpoints and share results in a Google Sheet. Lauren will lead tests with Jake and the HorizonCare app team during week 1 of the POC.

-Lauren
Lauren Bishop
